ETH.note: Consultation on the startup proclamation is not stated to be online.
Startup proclamation consultation is not a stated digital law, and who took part is not said.

facts.fact: The document says the call for applications to the timbuktoo ManuTech Hub was announced at a public consultation of Ethiopia's startup proclamation.
The document says UNDP and the Ministry of Industry launched the timbuktoo ManuTech Hub in Addis Ababa, with space to be completed in early 2025 and a first cohort then.
